refactor(i18n): standardize Fluent message IDs on hyphens only (#179)

Replace dotted localization keys across clarity_stac manifests, Dart
authoring, bundled shell assets, and tests with hyphenated IDs such as
home-title. Reject dots in aviaryLocalized and composition schemas, and
remove runtime dot-to-hyphen fallback in Swan and basic components.
